ResearchProjectDef.label: Lithic Essentials
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to properly create and grow Terrathyst; a crystal that forms an ever-strengthening lattice the more of it that is present, making it a infinitely usable material in terms of viability. Also teaches how to make a terrathyst crucible. Teaches you how to grow a terrathyst cultivator, which then grows numerous smaller crystals that can be harvested or shattered for terrathyst. The cultivator grows the smaller crystals year-round, and requires little interaction once grown. Nature is not only verdant plants and trees, but also the earth, primal elements, and even the cosmos. Terrathyst is just another terratech technique, and has it's own unique upsides and downsides, which tribes might prefer over organic matter. Terrathyst production takes slightly longer than organic production, due to their terrain sensitivity, and the need for many shards. However, their ease of understanding and shaping is just as simple as Prima creations, and terrathyst serves as the dominant material.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: You can now create a terrathyst crucible, and growths of terrathyst, which is your primary method of creating crystal-based structures and weapons. These are easy to grow, and don't require high fertility. They will grow in glowsap and shocksap bays. This crucible is used to form terrathyst seeds, and to charge or manipulate certain terrathyst items. It's usability is quite limited, however, and stronger, deeper structures are needed for larger items, and more demanding recipes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Prismite Well
ResearchProjectDef.description: Learn how to shape a unique seed that will grow into a prismite well. This well has a decently deep pool of shocksap, providing more room and sap than a crucible. The prismite well is a terrastructure that is quite common, as it allows tribes to access most things they'll ever need to do with terrathyst. That said, there are other creations that simply require more space, more sap, or even a different type of sap entirely to make. These kind of creations are utilized by tribes that have fully dedicated to a lithic lifestyle.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: You now have access to the prismite well. True to the name, this structure channels quite deep into the planet, carrying up shocksap that's pulled from lower resevoirs and pools. It's usability is more than adequate for any tribe that wishes to use general lithic terratech. However, specialized and more advanced creations will require a pool of a larger and deeper size.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lore Entry: Hyperdense Materials
ResearchProjectDef.description: Records tell of various materials that are entirely natural, but seem to have no presence on the planet. Even though some methods of dense terrathyst is common terratechnology, far denser materials - some not even lithic - once existed. \n\nUpon researching, you will discover some information about possibilities known to exist, but not known to any on the Rimworld. This research currently doesn't grant anything; however, should it's contained knowledge ever come within reach, this information will help you achieve it quickly.
ResearchProjectDef.discoveredLetterText: You have discovered that original Terratech tribe somehow were able to subject various materials - organic and lithic alike - to immense pressure, creating powerful, brand new materials with special traits. The history you pieced together tells of three: \nBiothite, a formless material that had both durability and utility. Research indicates it was a lithic material, but had features that were supposed to be exclusive to organic terratech. This made it a highly desirable amongst lithic tribes. Stellite, which is documented as the 'ultimate achievement'. Multiple people were required to move even a handful of it, while anything of a larger size was nearly indestructable. While this was used to enhance plant growths, records mostly indicate it was essential for creating specialized weapons and structures that exploited pure light. How light was compressed - and even captured - is another mystery entirely. Esperium, which was said to both defend against, and utilize, mental energies. Research indicates esperium was most commonly used in defensive practices, but also had quality-of-life utility. Not much is documented about Esperium, however, suggesting it was an underdeveloped or rare material. Other materials - such as Tallorium, Prismium, and Genesite - are mentioned, but no information regarding them could be pieced together.
